subject: Copywriting
title: The Headline: Your One Shot
description: A 1-minute de-risking session on The Headline: Your One Shot.

hook.text: Ogilvy said: 'Five times as many people read the headline as read the body copy.' The headline IS the ad for most.

buildup.text: In a sales letter, the headline appears after the salutation. It's often bold, sometimes in a different color or font.

discovery.text: Winning headline formulas: 'How to...' 'The Secret of...' 'Warning:...' 'At Last...' Each triggers a different emotion.

twist.text: The headline doesn't need to be clever. 'How to Win Friends and Influence People' is plain—but specific and beneficial.

climax.text: Test headlines before anything else. A headline change can multiply response 19x. No other element has that leverage.

punchline.text: 19x from one headline change. No other element has that leverage.

quiz.question: According to Ogilvy, how many more people read the headline than the body?
